page.overview:
What is Egghead Incident?

The Egghead Incident was an event that occurred when the World Government learned that Dr. Vegapunk had been studying the forbidden knowledge of the Void Century and decided to assassinate him while one of the Four Emperors, Monkey D. Luffy, barricaded himself on the island of Egghead. However, Morgans reported the incident in the news to the public that the Straw Hat Pirates had taken Vegapunk hostage, whilst the Marines were attempting to save him.

Given the presence of Vegapunk (who was researching the secrets of the world) and Luffy (who had awakened the power of an ancient god), as well as the arrival of Bartholomew Kuma (a survivor of the Buccaneers), a Buster Call was initiated by Jaygarcia Saturn, one of the Five Elders, to destroy the island. As matters escalated, the remaining Elders descended upon the island to personally handle the situation with their unfathomable powers.

Although the World Government's forces were successful in killing Vegapunk's Stella body, all of his Satellites survived, with Lilith escaping with the Straw Hat Pirates and the remaining rebellious Satellites escaping into the clouds along with Punk Records. In addition, the World Government's forces were unable to stop Vegapunk from posthumously broadcasting a damning message all across the world, which revealed significant information that the World Government had been attempting to suppress.

For his part in the operation's failure, Saturn's immortality was immediately revoked by Nerona Imu, resulting in his death. Imu simultaneously assigned Figarland Garling to Saturn's old position as one of the Five Elders.
